review:
Hacksaw's Zeus returns on a ways grid with CoinWays: Gold Coins add values up to 10x to a Coin Bar when they're part of a CoinWays win.

Three FS trigger the bonus, but the standout is Hot 100 – land three of its symbols and you get 100 free spins, way longer than a normal Hacksaw feature. Rated 4/5, 12,500x max, RTP versions from 96.39% down to 86.32%. Great if you love long bonuses.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.32% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
